description: UK Companies House bulk products: Basic Company Data (all live companies, monthly) and the People with Significant Control snapshot (daily), normalized to company entities and dated beneficial ownership/control assertions with natures of control

sampling.reason: Bulk ZIP products are acquired with wm acquire; no bounded sample endpoint configured

source.license_notes: Open Government Licence v3.0: reuse permitted with attribution 'Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0'. PSC data include personal data of individuals published under statutory register rules; normalization keeps name, nationality, country of residence and control facts only (no birth dates or addresses).

acquisition.description: BasicCompanyDataAsOneFile-2026-09-01.zip (492,551,925 bytes) and persons-with-significant-control-snapshot-2026-09-15.zip (2,213,176,181 bytes), sizes verified 2026-09-15. Activated after the shared budget rose to 50 GiB; both file names change (monthly/daily).

coverage.scope: All UK companies in Basic Company Data 2026-09-01 and every PSC register entry in the 2026-09-15 snapshot
